thread:
Asha: Quick sync — Palisade (enterprise POC) wants to deploy a custom adapter. They've sent a model bundle (palisade-v1.3.tar.gz). Main asks: catalog fit, kv-cache compatibility, recommended quant/variant, and pricing estimate for 5k rps peak during POC. Need input for security questionnaire too. Timeline: kickoff next Tue. Artifact: https://s3.company/palisade-v1.3.tar.gz
Miguel: Thanks — tagging Priya and Tom. Can you share model size and typical seq len? Also is the tokenizer standard BPE?
Priya: I pulled the bundle. Model is ~28.7GB FP32 (14B-ish). Tokenizer = custom-BPE, vocab ~50k. Sequence targets: 2048 typical, 8192 long-form tests.
Asha: Customer says most calls are 1024-2048, but long docs up to 8k in some flows. They want latency < 120ms for 1024 tokens.
Priya: For 1024 SLO, we should try q3f16->q4x8 variant (quant aware). Need to run variant-compat check. Also confirm KV cache shape: causal LM with standard KV layout.
Miguel: Is there a quick command to run compatibility check? I can ask the customer's infra to run it on their side.
Priya: Yep — run: ```./compat-check --model palisade-v1.3.tar.gz --tokenizer custom-bpe --max-seq 2048 --out report.json``` It validates KV layout, rmsnorm hooks, and tokenizer mapping. Expect ~10-20m.
InfraBot: Deploy job queued: compat-check-palisade-8290001111. Status: queued -> running.
Priya: If compat-check passes, next step is catalog ingest + variant build (we'll build q4x8 and a quant-no-kv fallback). Need dedicated GPU for long-form perf runs (A100/80GB recommended).
Tom: Security: send customer the standard security questionnaire, but note we need model provenance checklist + I/O data flows for Private deployment. Also confirm whether model contains third-party sensitive data — legal will need that.
Asha: They requested Hosted initially, but they require data isolation later — likely Dedicated or Private ramp. Pricing estimate: what would 5k rps peak look like for POC? (mostly 1024 tokens request, average 150 tokens response)
Priya: Rough calc: token throughput = 5k * (1024+150) ~ 5.87M tokens/s? Wait units: per second is huge. Maybe 5k rps across region -> 5k requests/sec. For 1024 tokens request + 150 response = 1174 tokens/rpc -> 5k*1174=5.87M tokens/sec -> that's infeasible. Probably they mean 5k rps per minute? Clarify.
Miguel: Asha — can you confirm units? POC expected concurrent requests or total RPS? Also what's allowed burst.
Asha: My bad — they meant 5k requests/min peak. So ~83 rps. That sounds reasonable for POC.
Priya: For 83 rps with batching and q4x8 variant, a small Dedicated pool (2x A100-80GB with autoscale) should suffice for latency SLOs. Estimate hosted cost ~ $X/day (approx $0.06/token ?). I'll send a calc.
Miguel: For pricing for sales, give two options: Hosted trial estimate, and Dedicated reserved estimate with monthly commit. Also add quantization labor (variant build) as one-time eng effort ~ 4 engineering days.
Asha: Noted. Tom — what security docs do we need to provide now vs. later for Dedicated/Private?
Tom: Now: SOC2 attestation summary, network diagram for Hosted flow, encryption at rest/in transit. For Private: KMS/HSM details, access controls, audit log retention. I'll prepare bullet list and share.
Priya: One gotcha: custom tokenizer — need to verify tokenization mapping with our embedding pipeline and reranker. The compat-check covers that but we might need mapping patch.
Miguel: Action items:
- Asha: confirm 5k/min and get customer contact + attach model checksum
- Priya: run compat-check + build q4x8 variant if pass
- Tom: prepare security doc checklist & starter responses
- Miguel: prepare pricing two-option estimate and POC runbook
Please update this thread when each item is done. :thumbsup:
Asha: I'll get the checksum and customer SRE contact. Kickoff scheduled Tue 10am PT. Thanks all.
Priya: FYI if compat-check fails on rmsnorm we can try a tiny adaptor shim; not a blocker usually.
InfraBot: compat-check-palisade-8290001111 completed: PASS. report: https://ci.internal/reports/8290001111/compat-report.json
Miguel: Awesome — Priya, can you start variant build? Asha, I'll draft the estimate.
Priya: Starting build now. I'll post results and perf numbers (1024 latency p50/p95) in this thread.
Asha: :raised_hands:
